message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to live exchange‑rate feeds, so I can’t give you the exact figure for today.  
As a rough guide, the USD/GBP rate has usually hovered around **0.75–0.80 GBP per USD** in recent months. Using a mid‑point of 0.78 GBP/USD:

```
$20 × 0.78 GBP/USD ≈ £15.60
```

So you can expect roughly **£15–£16** for $20, but the exact amount will depend on the current market rate and any bank or service fees. For the most accurate conversion, check a trusted financial news site, your bank’s currency converter, or a currency‑exchange app.
